title: TailTrail Proof Binding
description: What a reproduction_binding/post_change_binding id (as referenced by schemas/host-input-contract.schema.json's correction proof shape) resolves to. Reproduction shows the original expected-vs-actual symptom at the public route; post-change proof must cover the same positive behavior plus its preservation boundary -- the two kinds are never interchangeable (TAILTRAIL-HOST-QUESTION-FLOW-DESIGN.md, 'Correction Premise Contract' and Phase 5 of the implementation plan). An executable passing suite with no requirement-linked assertion is not symptom-specific proof, so every binding must name at least one asserted_behavior and the scenario/assertion that establishes it.

kind.description: reproduction: demonstrates the original failing symptom at the public route. post-change: demonstrates the corrected positive behavior plus its preservation boundary.

preservation_boundaries.description: Only meaningful for kind=post-change: the preserved behaviors the correction must not regress.

paired_binding_id.description: For kind=post-change, the proof_binding_id of the reproduction this binding corrects; for kind=reproduction, the post-change binding that will close it once implemented (may be absent until then).
